title: Newmark Facilitates 21,105-SF Precision Manufacturing Lease in Rancho Cordova, California

body_markdown:
**September 10, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has facilitated a 21,105-square-foot industrial lease on behalf of Nominal Machining at 11415 Folsom Boulevard in Rancho Cordova, California. Senior Managing Director[Mike Smith](https://www.nmrk.com/people/mike-smith) , Associate Director[Cole Cummings](https://www.nmrk.com/people/cole-cummings) and Associate[Irina Shpyrka](https://www.nmrk.com/people/irina-shpyrka) represented the tenant in the transaction.


Nominal Machining is a precision computer numerical control (“CNC”) machine manufacturing company (ISO 9001, AS9100D, ITAR-registered) serving aerospace, defense, semiconductor and medical clients in the Sacramento region. The property at 11415 Folsom delivered heavy power and electrical infrastructure, a fully conditioned warehouse envelope suitable for tight-tolerance machining and metrology, direct Highway 50 visibility and access along Rancho Cordova’s most active industrial corridor, suiting the client’s needs. WCM Investment Management is the property’s owner.


“Nominal needed three things at the same time — the right location, the right power, and fully conditioned space — and that combination is genuinely scarce in this market,” said Cummings. “11415 Folsom checks all three boxes: Highway 50 frontage, heavy power with a path to more, and a fully conditioned building envelope. Power is the driver for these manufacturing tenants today, and buildings that can deliver power don’t stay vacant long.”


Occupiers remain active in Sacramento’s eastern corridor despite a more measured leasing environment. For precision manufacturers, defense-electronics users and advanced light-industrial occupiers, Rancho Cordova offers a rare combination of transportation connectivity, delivered building infrastructure, and occupancy costs that compare favorably to larger California markets.


[According to Newmark Research](https://www.nmrk.com/insights/market-report/sacramento-market-reports) , Sacramento’s industrial market showed signs of renewed momentum during the second quarter of 2026. Regional leasing activity increased nearly 70% quarter-over-quarter as tenants moved forward with previously deferred real estate decisions, while vacancy improved to 7%, well below the long-term market average of 8.4%.


The 50 Corridor East submarket, where Rancho Cordova is located, posted a vacancy rate of just 4.1% and recorded more than 317,000 square feet of positive absorption in the second quarter, reflecting continued tenant demand for strategically located industrial space.
